table.retrieve:
SELECT	h.receiptinvcode, 
	h.date, 
	department=dpt.name,
	Round(sum(d.qty * d.avgprice), 0) as Cost, 
	Round(sum(d.qty * d.saleprice), 0) as SaleValue, 
	Round(sum(d.qty * d.purchaseprice), 0) as PurchaseValue, 
	h.salesmancode, 
	u.username, 
	h.posted 
FROM 	receiptheader h, receiptdetail d, users u, department dpt
WHERE 	h.receiptinvcode = d.receiptinvcode and 
	h.date >= :ar_startdate and 
	h.date <= :ar_enddate and
	h.salesmancode = u.usercode and
	h.deptcode = dpt.deptcode and
	h.posted='Y'
GROUP BY h.receiptinvcode, h.date, h.salesmancode, u.username, dpt.name, h.posted
